title: Network Management Tools: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A building superintendent has several tools. Each one does a different job. Picking the right one is the skill.

scenes.heading: The superintendent
scenes.narration: Each protocol answers a different question. S N M P polls devices and sends traps. Syslog collects event messages. NetFlow shows who is talking to whom. Severity zero is the most critical in syslog.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. S N M P traps alert in real time. S N M P gives interface totals. Zero is the most critical.

items.wrong: Syslog is best for real-time alerts
Level one is the most critical

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva management tools lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. S N M P polls, syslog logs, and NetFlow shows flows. Zero is the worst syslog level. Know the ports: one sixty one, five fourteen, two zero five five. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva management tools lab.

points.t: SNMP polls; syslog logs; NetFlow shows flows
